company.name: Dubai Memes
company.shortDescription: The simplest way for everyone to publish, collect and share fun memes and images about Dubai city.
company.description: The Dubai Memes generator is designed to be insanely fast and provide powerful customization, while still being simple and easy to use. If you think your images are funny/awesome enough to be worthy of the Dubai Memes homepage, you can submit them. All submitted memes are scanned by experts of the Dubai Memes who will determine whether they are appropriate and worth showing. After successful login via Facebook or Google, DubaiMemes.com users can to save created memes permanently.
